_about: Owned by batch B5 (Prompts and panel). Checked against core.json, b3.json and b4.json first: no clash.

panel.short: The React page dsh-superagent injects into DeepSeek Harness's own web sidebar, for supervising and configuring it.
panel.long: {{cite src/client/index.tsx:49-58}}'s apply() injects a sidebar icon, the main panel component and a Plugin Manager config view into DSH's own slots.

team-section.short: One of three prompt sections a team writes directly: Communication, Ticket scope and Delivery requirements.
team-section.long: {{cite src/app/prompts.ts:14-17}} lists the three sections and the exact heading each one gets in the composed prompt.

built-in-part.short: One named built-in text, such as runtime/admission or a Source skill, that a team may override with its own text.
built-in-part.long: {{cite src/app/prompts.ts:24-26}} lists the 15 parts a team may override, by the key an override names them by.

source-skill.short: A bundled Skill that teaches the agents a Source's own tools, such as GitHub's gh CLI or reading a Feishu chat.
source-skill.long: dsh-superagent bundles exactly two: {{cite skills/dsh-superagent-github/SKILL.md}} and {{cite skills/dsh-superagent-feishu/SKILL.md}}. Each is registered as a DSH Skill in every Session's skill scope, the Feishu one only when a Feishu bot is configured ({{cite src/app/prompts.ts:146-148}}, {{cite src/app/sessions.ts:319-324}}); see the sibling site's "Skills" for how DSH itself loads one on demand.

prompt-revision.short: One saved, numbered version of a role's prompt configuration: the team sections, overrides and skills, together.
prompt-revision.long: {{cite src/app/prompts.ts:39-41}} is the stored shape: a revision number, its predecessor, when and where it was saved, and the full configuration.

settings-block.short: One named part of Settings, such as policy, executor or one Source, saved on its own with its own revision counter.
settings-block.long: {{cite src/app/settings.ts:32-52}} lists the block kinds; {{cite src/app/store.ts:188}} keeps each block's own revision counter.
